name: sketchi-code-mode-codex
description: Sketchi Code Mode skill and MCP config for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Sketchi draws 15 kinds of diagram, from flowcharts and architecture maps to ER diagrams and Gantt charts, as editable Excalidraw scenes with a PNG. The plugin adds its public MCP server and a skill that tells Codex how to use it.
defaultPrompt: Use Sketchi to draw our release approval flow as a flowchart.
Use Sketchi to draw this database schema as an ER diagram.
Color the approval step purple in the Sketchi flowchart.
